title: Provider-neutral OpenDesk-style adapter contract

unsupported_capability.retry: only after a new capability report or adapter version

invariants: The adapter is an offline model and never launches, authenticates, or contacts a provider.
A known but unadvertised capability returns unsupported_capability without execution or lifecycle state change.
An unknown capability, stale revision, malformed digest, privacy-bearing value, or invalid transition is rejected without state change.
Supported requests accept only bounded digest references; prompts, transcripts, credentials, paths, and raw output are not contract data.
Every outcome preserves one exact task revision, session/worktree binding, and adapter identity.
Terminal states fence all later requests, and unsupported capability is never reported as success.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

privacy.projection: identities, capabilities, bounded dispositions, and digests only

limitations: The reference model proves contract shape and deterministic state transitions only; it does not prove OpenDesk or any provider availability.
Capability advertisement is an offline input and does not establish authorization, implementation support, model behavior, or network reachability.
Provider launch, credentials, streaming transport, tool execution, files, resume, supervision, and remote runtime are outside this AR.
follow_up: AR-0018 defines production supervision and provider process integration.
Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI remain authoritative for their respective domains.
